units: SVG user units, shared by tractor and trailer. Tractor 96u ~ 23 ft long (width exaggerated about 1.6x for readability). Trailer 190u ~ 53 ft. A 2.0 length ratio vs 2.3 in real life keeps the proportions close while the tractor stays readable.
orientation: All sprites point UP (front = smaller y). Heading 0 = north; rotate clockwise by heading in degrees (CSS rotate(Hdeg)).

ironcrest.selected: far-ironcrest-selected.svg (thin chrome ring, no yellow halo)

bannerline.selected: far-bannerline-selected.svg (thin chrome ring, no yellow halo)

highvale.selected: far-highvale-selected.svg (thin chrome ring, no yellow halo)

tractor.note: Same units as the tractor; position it so the kingpin is at (20,80) in both coordinate systems. Its box is larger because it includes the beams.

files.tractor-beams.svg: two warm headlight cones (the yellow halo was removed in favor of chicken lights)

lights.note2: Every light file shares the viewBox of its sprite's light frame (tractor-* use the tractor lights viewBox, trailer-* use the trailer lights viewBox). All are radial gradients; there is no feGaussianBlur.

selected.ring: thin 1.5px ring in --dk-chicken at 55% + dark ground shadow

lights.blend: none: mix-blend-mode is OFF on beams (it forced extra compositing on every moving rig); beams are plain opacity layers

displayScale.note: px = rendered height of the TRACTOR sprite. The trailer uses the same px-per-unit: trailerPx = tractorPx*190/96
displayScale.devicePixelRatio: SVGs are vector, so no @2x is needed. Round the translate to 0.5px to avoid shimmer.

kinematics: F = tractor front (u=(20,1)) follows the route. K = F - unit(F-K_prev)*79u (kingpin). A = K - unit(K-A_prev)*154u (trailer rear axle). Tractor heading = bearing(K->F), trailer heading = bearing(A->K). CSS: translate(Kx,Ky) rotate(heading deg) for every layer, with transform-origin at the kingpin.
legacy: legacy/*-selected.svg (gold glow + crown) are superseded by chicken lights + .dk-rig--selected

files.inline: chicken.js -> window.DK_CHICKEN.{tractor,trailer} (SVG strings), turned into cached blob-URL src per part+palette

outline.tractor: bumper, drop visor, cab sides, fuel tanks, sleeper sides, sleeper top+rear edges
outline.trailer: front top edge, both sides, rear

chicken.dotMarkup: <g class=ck style=--i:N> 4 circles: bloom r3.6 a.12, bloom r2.1 a.3, core r1.05, white hot-spot r.4</g> (no blur filters)
chicken.colorVar: --dk-chicken (default #ffb020): palette source of truth (read via getComputedStyle, or palettes[].color) baked into the blob SVG; also colors the selected ring

palettes.color: multicolor (hsl by dot index), animated chase

chicken.zIndex: tractor-chicken sits above the tractor sprite (5.5); trailer-chicken sits above the trailer (2.5)
chicken.render: Render as (src = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([svgString],{type:'image/svg+xml'})), cached per part+palette[+still]), NOT inline , so bake the palette color into the root color="..." attribute (dots use currentColor) and, for chase, inject a

pathFollow.summary: Preferred over kinematic follow. Put every axle point ON the route polyline. Use Euclidean distance (rigid body) but search along the arc so the trailer cuts corners exactly like a real rig.
steps: Precompute cumulative arc length cum[i] for route points (layer px at the current zoom, or meters via map.distance()).
s = arc position of the tractor FRONT axle (or of the kingpin if you only track that).
If null (start of route / off-path): fall back to follow(prev,lead,L).
pathFollow.jsFunction: pointAtDistanceBehind(pts,s,L) and pointAtArc(pts,s) in README.md (pts=[{x,y,cum}] in layer px); demo.html has a working array-based version
pathFollow.leaflet: pts from map.latLngToLayerPoint(latlng) per zoom (rebuild on zoomend), or cum in meters via map.distance() with L converted to meters
pathFollow.units: u = tractorPx/96 px per SVG unit. In meters: tractor 79u ~ 5.6 m display-exaggerated; use the px math so sprites line up with the art.
pathFollow.intersection: Walking back from P0=pointAtArc(s), the first vertex B with |B-P0|>=L brackets the crossing on segment B->E (E = next point toward P0, inside the circle). Solve |B+t(E-B)-P0|=L and take the SMALLER root t=(-b-sqrt(b^2-4ac))/(2a) (the crossing toward B, farther back along the route). The +sqrt root lies past t=1 and clamps to E, snapping the trailer to a vertex at the wrong distance on sparse routes. Matches pab() in index.html (72b5d3a).
